instruction.text: Read the sentences and select the singular possessive noun(s).

hint.text: Possessive nouns show that someone or something owns something.

atoms.b: Pierre is spending the afternoon with his friend, Sasha. ((Sasha’s)) car is in the repair shop, which is why she came by bicycle.

instruction.text: Write the correct possessive in the gap using the word in brackets.

atoms.b: Do you already know what you are going to bring to ((Josie’s)) [Josie] dinner party?
atoms.sound: Do you already know what you are going to bring to Josie’s dinner party?

atoms.b: Have you ever attempted to count a ((tree’s)) [tree] falling leaves?
atoms.sound: have you ever attempted to count a tree’s falling leaves

atoms.b: One practical thing about living in the city is the public ((transport’s)) [transport] frequency. You never have to wait too long.
atoms.sound: One practical thing about living in the city is the public transport’s frequency. You never have to wait too long.

atoms.b: My ((mother’s)) [mother] headphones from the 90's are still functioning.
atoms.sound: My mother’s headphones from the 90's are still functioning.

atoms.b: My ((girlfriend’s)) [girlfriend] lucky helmet has accompanied her in every paragliding course.
atoms.sound: My girlfriend’s lucky helmet has accompanied her in every paragliding course

instruction.text: Rewrite the phrases using a possessive noun.

atoms.a: the bread basket of the baker
the observing eyes of five owls

instruction.text: Choose the correct possessive form in the following examples.

atoms.b: Sandra((++’s s s’)) smoothies are always full of superfoods.
atoms.sound: Sandra’s smoothies are always full of superfoods.

atoms.b: Her mother and father((s’ s ++’s)) cherry blossom trees bloom so beautifully in the Spring.
atoms.sound: Her mother and father’s cherry blossom trees bloom so beautifully in the Spring.
